name: checked-expr-negative-test-764bc995e0/checked-error-return-type-mismatch-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: supported statement list does not include named worker declarations or do/on fail statements.
## Expressions: lists ‘Wait action’ and ‘Check expression’, but does not list worker send or receive actions.

## Import declarations: ‘Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported’; ballerina/lang.array lists length, push, map, indexOf, remove, removeAll, toStream, toBase64, toBase16, fromBase64, fromBase16, but not forEach.
### Other invocation restrictions: ‘Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:’ lists array methods but omits array:forEach.
reason: The complete negative case requires named workers, worker communication (5 -> w2 and <- w1), do/on fail handling, and an array forEach callback. These are outside the supported positive lists; array:forEach is also excluded by the langlib restrictions. Supported check expressions alone do not make the whole case in scope.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations and worker send/receive actions
do/on fail and worker on fail clauses
test_design_notes: The file asserts compile-time rejection using @error comments, including checks in worker and nested callback contexts; it has no @args, @panic or @output assertions.
The ordinary function check/error return-type mismatches could be separated into a supported negative case; unsupported worker and on-fail contexts prevent whole-case bug classification.
